title: KTX live-brain mode (mode 30) - on-box live loop

build.verified_clean_room: stock 08807da -> baseline -> live -> p99 (git apply --recount) -> cmake

live_cmds.example: slot 1 LIVE fwd=1 side=-1 jump=0 (req=4243 ans=4242)

on_ktx_p99_us.scope: per-slot per-tick (one sample per BotApplyMoveProbeLive call)
on_ktx_p99_us.measure: build-world-view + write VIEW + read MOVE + apply, inside KTX
on_ktx_p99_us.frame_budget_note: the 500us T0.2 budget is per server frame; a frame services <= MSHM_MAX_SLOTS (4) live slots, so per-frame aggregate <= ~4x the per-slot figures
on_ktx_p99_us.verdict: per-slot p99 <=5us; per-frame aggregate ~20us, ~25x under the 500us frame budget; closes the T0.2 loop on the real server
